description: This Scala source file defines the HBaseDelegationTokenProvider class, which manages obtaining and handling delegation tokens for HBase security within Spark. It includes methods for fetching tokens via reflection, handling different HBase API versions, and checking if delegation tokens are required based on configuration.

classes.name: HBaseDelegationTokenProvider
classes.description: A class that provides delegation tokens for HBase security in Spark, handling token retrieval via reflection and supporting different HBase API versions.

methods.name: obtainDelegationTokens
methods.description: Attempts to obtain HBase delegation tokens using reflection, falling back to connection-based token retrieval if necessary.

methods.name: obtainDelegationTokensWithHBaseConn
methods.description: Uses HBase connection API via reflection to obtain delegation tokens, supporting HBase API versions 0.98.9 and above.

methods.name: delegationTokensRequired
methods.description: Checks if delegation tokens are required based on HBase security configuration.

methods.name: hbaseConf
methods.description: Creates or retrieves an HBase Configuration object, handling cases where the class may not be available.
